items.name: Mantle of the Dragon-Oath
items.lore: Volur grey and King's blue. Given to those who broke the Wyrm-Temple.

items.name: True-Name Torc
items.lore: Silver, the half-name burned out of it.

items.name: Girdle of the Wyrm-Temple
items.lore: Red scale, from the temple's own door.

items.name: Ring of the Broken Rite
items.lore: A rite-knife, bent into a ring.

items.name: Scale-Breaker Bracer
items.lore: Iron, with a drakulv scale cracked through.

items.name: Volva's Eye Jewel
items.lore: A pale stone. Groa says it sees.

items.name: Hierophant's Eye-Crown
items.lore: The dragon's eye from his brow, on a chain. It's closed now.

items.name: Wyrm-Guard's Scale
items.lore: A plate of the Wyrm-Guard's dragon-scale, bound as a bracer.

items.name: Brood-Elder's Tooth
items.lore: A tooth as long as a hand, still hot.
